package.name: omni_face
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 2): the face on the 7 in display and the voice on the speaker. face_node turns the console's status into what to show and say (moments.py); the display program (pygame, no desktop, no browser) draws it full screen on the robot and plays the sounds and speech (Piper / espeak-ng; Windows' voice in the sim).
